name: TG–DTG panels stacked (one material per panel)
use_case: One TG–DTG graph per material (twin axis, DTG at its natural sign), the total mass loss written in each panel, your reference lines and your notes with arrows.

data_roles.notes: your notes (typed in the editor): panel; text; x; y; text x; text y

origin_hint: Origin: Double-Y graphs merged vertically (Merge Graph Windows, 1 column); notes via Insert > Text and Arrow.
calculations: total mass loss = first mass − last mass
DTG = smoothed derivative of the mass
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
